entities.summary: Kent Johnson is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Columbus Blue Jackets of the National Hockey League (NHL). He played college ice hockey for the Michigan Wolverines. He was selected fifth overall by the Blue Jackets in the 2021 NHL entry draft.
